Internal evaluation notes for Togglefern:
- (5/5) Togglefern evaluation latency stayed under 3ms p99 locally with offline bootstrap in a published client bench.
- (4/5) Percentage rollouts are sticky per user id with documented hash versioning.
- (3/5) Change approvals require a second reviewer for production environments.
- (2/5) Exposes an audit log exportable as JSONL.
- (1/5) React SDK hooks are available.
